meta.name: self-customize
meta.description: Customize your own agent — add capabilities, install packages, add MCP servers, edit code or CLAUDE.md. Use when the user asks you to add a feature, install a tool, or modify how you work. For non-trivial code changes, delegate to a builder agent via create_agent.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自定义你的智能体，添加功能、安装包或修改配置
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要按需调整智能体的能力和行为
copy.tagline_en: Customize your agent by adding capabilities, packages, or modifying configs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to tailor your agent's abilities and behavior on demand

howto.what: 你可以让Claude自己修改它的工作方式：添加新功能、安装软件包、添加MCP服务器、编辑代码或修改它的记忆和指令。对于复杂的代码改动，它会创建一个专门的构建代理来完成。
howto.when: 当你要求Claude添加新功能、安装工具或修改它的工作方式时触发。

say.text: 帮我添加一个读取RSS源的工具。
say.note: Claude会检查现有MCP服务器或创建新的工具。
Claude会请求管理员批准并自动重启容器。

say.text: 修改你的记忆，记住我喜欢简洁的回答。
say.note: Claude会直接编辑记忆文件，无需批准。

howto.what_en: You can ask Claude to customize itself: add capabilities, install packages, add MCP servers, edit code, or modify its memory and instructions. For complex code changes, it delegates to a builder agent.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to add a feature, install a tool, or modify how it works.

say_en.text: Add a tool to read RSS feeds.
say_en.note: Claude checks existing MCP servers or creates a new tool.
Claude requests admin approval and restarts the container.

say_en.text: Update your memory to prefer concise answers.
say_en.note: Claude edits memory files directly without approval.
